# Little Fight NYC — review candidate

> Custom websites, hands-on technology support, free consulting and software clients own for small businesses.

This is a noindex design review candidate. The current official business website is https://littlefightnyc.com/. Do not treat this preview as a new business, studio, location, or public launch.

## Business facts

- Name: Little Fight NYC (LFNYC)
- Email: hello@littlefightnyc.com
- Phone: +1 646 360 0318
- On-site support: all five New York City boroughs
- Website work: nationwide
- Consulting: always free; paid implementation follows an agreed scope
- Ownership: clients own their code, data, domain, hosting and documentation
